themes.quote: we are progressing a series of development initiatives across our generation portfolio, including nuclear uprates and other capacity expansions
we continue to engage in discussions with various counterparties regarding the potential long-term sale of power from our generation facilities
Planned Gas-Fueled Dispatchable Power in ERCOT... up to 2,000 MW of dispatchable, natural gas-fueled electricity capacity in west, central, and north Texas
We have nuclear fuel contracted to support all our refueling needs through 2030 without any additional Russian deliveries

Electricity demand drivers including the rise of large scale data centers, the electrification of oil field operations, and electric vehicle load building are contributing to a projected fast paced load growth in the regions we serve
Vistra executed definitive agreements to acquire Cogentrix Energy which consists of 10 modern natural gas generation facilities totaling approximately 5,500 MW of capacity
entered into 20-year PPAs with Amazon Web Services and Meta to supply carbon-free power from our nuclear plants
planned uprates at Perry, Davis-Besse, and Beaver Valley would add 433 MW of incremental carbon-free nuclear energy and capacity
executed definitive agreements to acquire Cogentrix Energy consisting of 5,500 MW of capacity and acquired 2,600 MW from Lotus
application for license renewal at Perry Nuclear Plant was approved by the NRC, extending through 2046
our integrated power generation and retail electricity business provides flexibility to hedge our generation position by utilizing retail markets as an effective sales channel

Vistra entered into a 20-year power purchase agreement with a large, investment grade company pursuant to which Vistra has agreed to supply to the Customer 1,200 MW of carbon-free power from the Comanche Peak Nuclear Power Plant
we announced we will move forward with construction of the 860 MW peaking plants discussed above. Early development work is underway, and we anticipate the units will be online in 2028

themes.theme: nuclear fleet acquisition and geographic diversification
themes.quote: Vistra Operations acquired 100% of the membership interests of subsidiaries of Lotus resulting in the addition of seven natural gas generation facilities totaling 2,600 MW in Delaware and Pennsylvania (PJM), Rhode Island (ISO-NE), New York
our application for license renewal at our Perry Nuclear Plant was approved by the NRC. The license now extends through 2046
the section 45U nuclear PTC is available to existing nuclear facilities from 2024 through 2032 and provides a federal tax credit of up to $15 per MWh
